task_title: Render approved baseball-bat-v1 art on the in-game melee swing

plan_review.notes: rubber-duck gpt-5.4 (high) plan-reviewed the change against src/engine/PhaserBridge.ts, src/engine/InventoryUI.ts, src/shared/generated-assets.ts, and the manifest. Two concerns raised — both addressed before commit b12cef4c: (1) BLOCKING — MIN_WEAPON_SPRITE_SCALE=1.8 floor applied to generated 64x64 bat art produces scale 1.8 instead of ~0.73 (holdY=60, bladeLen=44), putting the tip ~108 px from the hand instead of 44. Fix: the floor is now scoped to the Kenney 16px fallback path (isGeneratedWeaponSprite gate); generated art uses raw `bladeLen/holdY` unclamped so the tip lands exactly at bladeLen. (2) IMPORTANT — key-only reconcile misses same-sheet frame differences (bat frame 117 vs sword frame 72 both live on 'kenney-tiny-dungeon'). Fix: reconcile now compares both texture key AND frame name via `img.texture.key` + `img.frame?.name`. Reviewer confirmed 'baseball-bat-v1' is the correct briefId (manifest entry 'baseball-bat-v1-var-0', briefId 'baseball-bat-v1'), that `eid | 0` is an acceptable seed today (single approved variant — noted as a follow-up if more land), no other runtime code path renders 'weapon.bat', and that leaving `getMeleeSpriteId` (hammer discrepancy) alone is correctly scoped.

code_review.notes: The plan-review pass acted as the initial code-review pass since it inspected the actual diff (imports, resolution branching, anchor/scale math, reconcile logic). Both concerns folded into commit b12cef4c before push.
